PROJECT KAOS-BYTE4.1.0v - THE STATIC RIFT (build XII)
A virtual Portal of Power for the six Xbox 360 Skylanders games.
You do NOT need a real portal. The Static Rift is the portal.
=============================================================================


1. WHICH DOWNLOAD DO I NEED?
----------------------------
On the GitHub page, click "Releases" (on the right), open the newest
release and look under "Assets". Download ONE of these:
- Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-Release.zip ........ consoles with PEER PRESSURE
                                     (with the phone remote, see 7)
- Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-RGH-Release.zip .... RGH, JTAG, or BADUPDATE + XeUnshackle
                                     (anything that runs Dashlaunch plugins;
                                     with the phone remote too, see 7)
Do NOT download "Source code" or use the green "Code" button: that's the
code for building the plugin, not the plugin itself (there's no Plugins
folder in it).
Already installed an older version? The small Update zips (no pictures)
are all you need: see 5.

You put NOTHING inside your game's folder. The plugin goes in its own
folder on the hard drive, and the game finds it from there.


2. CONNECTING WITH FILEZILLA (FIRST TIME)
-----------------------------------------
FileZilla copies files from your PC to the Xbox over your home network.
1. Install "FileZilla Client" (free, filezilla-project.org) on your PC.
2. Turn on the Xbox and go to your homebrew dashboard (Aurora, FSD...):
   its FTP server only runs while the dashboard is up. The PC and the
   Xbox must be on the same network (Wi-Fi or cable).
3. Find the Xbox's IP address (it looks like 192.168.1.23). Aurora shows
   it on its main screen. Or on the Xbox: Settings > System > Network
   Settings > your network > Configure Network.
4. In FileZilla, fill in the "Quickconnect" bar at the top:
     Host ........ the Xbox's IP address
     Username .... xboxftp   (Aurora; on FSD and most others: xbox)
     Password .... xboxftp   (Aurora; on FSD and most others: xbox)
     Port ........ 21
   and click Quickconnect.
5. Now the window has two sides:
     LEFT = your PC                RIGHT = the Xbox
   On the right you'll see drives like Hdd1, Usb0 and Flash. Hdd1 is the
   hard drive. Never change anything in Flash.
6. To copy something TO the Xbox, drag it from the left side to the right.
   To copy something FROM the Xbox (like launch.ini or a log), drag it
   from the right side to the left.
7. The bottom of the window shows the copying. Wait until "Queued files"
   is empty. If the "Failed transfers" tab lists anything, right-click in
   it, choose to requeue all the files, and let them copy again.


3. INSTALL - PEER PRESSURE
--------------------------
1. On your PC, right-click Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-Release.zip and choose
   "Extract All". Open the new Kaos-Byte4.1.0v folder: inside it are two
   folders, PeerPressure and The Static Rift (and this file).
2. In FileZilla, on the LEFT side, go into that Kaos-Byte4.1.0v folder.
3. On the RIGHT side, double-click Hdd1 so you're inside it.
4. On the left, click PeerPressure, hold Ctrl and click The Static Rift,
   then drag both onto the right side. If FileZilla asks about files that
   already exist, choose Overwrite. It's about 2,100 files: give it a few
   minutes.
5. Check: on the right you should now have Hdd1\PeerPressure\SideLoading
   with KaosByte.xex and six .ini files in it, and Hdd1\The Static Rift.
6. Start a Skylanders game. You'll see "The Static Rift is open".


4. INSTALL - RGH / JTAG / BADUPDATE (DASHLAUNCH)
------------------------------------------------
1. On your PC, right-click Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-RGH-Release.zip and choose
   "Extract All". Open the new Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-RGH folder: inside it are
   two folders, Plugins and The Static Rift (and this file). The plugin
   itself, KaosByteDSL.xex, is inside Plugins.
2. In FileZilla, on the LEFT side, go into that Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-RGH folder.
3. On the RIGHT side, double-click Hdd1 so you're inside it.
4. On the left, click Plugins, hold Ctrl and click The Static Rift, then
   drag both onto the right side. (Already have a Plugins folder? The new
   file is just added to it.) It's about 2,100 files: give it a few
   minutes.
5. Tell Dashlaunch to load the plugin. Dashlaunch reads a file called
   launch.ini. Which one:
     RGH / JTAG ...... launch.ini at the top of Hdd1.
     BadUpdate ....... launch.ini on your BadUpdate USB stick (Usb0 on the
                       right side). The one on the hard drive is NOT read.
                       Also drag the Plugins folder onto Usb0.
   a. Drag launch.ini from the right side to the left (copies it to your
      PC).
   b. On your PC, right-click launch.ini > Open with > Notepad.
   c. Find the line [Plugins]. Under it, add ONE line, using the first
      number that isn't used yet (plugin1 to plugin5). Don't change the
      lines that are already there.
        RGH / JTAG:  plugin1 = Hdd:\Plugins\KaosByteDSL.xex
        BadUpdate:   plugin1 = Usb:\Plugins\KaosByteDSL.xex
      Type it exactly like that: a space on each side of the = sign, and
      "Hdd:" (not "Hdd1:") - that's how Dashlaunch names the hard drive.
   d. Save it (Ctrl+S). Drag launch.ini from the left side back to the
      same place on the right, and choose Overwrite.
6. Restart the console (BadUpdate: run BadUpdate + XeUnshackle again).
7. Start a Skylanders game. You'll see "The Static Rift is open".


5. UPDATING FROM AN OLDER VERSION
---------------------------------
Use the Update zip (no menu pictures or figures):
  Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-Update.zip ........ Peer Pressure (about 7 MB: it
                                      brings the phone remote's small
                                      pictures, The Static Rift\Phone)
  Kaos-Byte4.1.0v-RGH-Update.zip .... RGH / JTAG / BadUpdate (the same,
                                      with the plugin in Plugins)
Drag its folders onto the root of Hdd1 and choose Overwrite. It has the
plugin, The Static Rift\UI and The Static Rift\Phone. Your settings
(staticrift.ini), pictures, figures, saves, picks.ini, nicknames and lists
(nicknames.ini, lists.ini) stay as they are.
  - Coming from Kaos-Byte2.0v? Also delete the old plugin:
      Peer Pressure: Kaos-Byte2.0v.xex in Hdd1\PeerPressure\SideLoading
      RGH/BadUpdate: Kaos-Byte2.0v-RGH.xex, and change your launch.ini
                     line to KaosByteDSL.xex (see 4, step 5)
  - Figures with no picture? Copy The Static Rift\Images from the full
    zip once.


6. USING IT
-----------
When the game starts you'll see "The Static Rift is open".
Tap LB + RB to open the menu. Tap it again (or press Back) to close it.
The game pauses while the menu is open and carries on when you close it.
The Xbox Guide button closes the menu (the Guide opens as normal).

  D-pad left/right .... previous / next figure (hold to scroll)
  D-pad up/down ....... previous / next section (like "Skylanders / Magic")
  LT / RT ............. jump back / forward 10 figures
  A ................... put the figure on the Rift
  Y ................... swap in (replaces the figure of the same kind)
  B ................... take the figure off
  X ................... clear the Rift
  START ............... give the figure a nickname (see below)
  R3 (click stick) .... next list: ALL -> FAVORITES and your own lists
                        (made on the phone, see 7) -> MY PICKS -> one
                        game at a time (Spyro's Adventure, Giants...)
                        -> ALL again

The three lists (the hint at the bottom says which one R3 goes to next):
  ALL ......... every figure the game you're playing can use, by type:
                gimmick Skylanders, Skylanders, creation crystals, traps,
                vehicles, magic items, adventure packs; then by element,
                then A to Z.
  MY PICKS .... your rosters from picks.ini (see 8), then every crystal,
                trap, vehicle, magic item and adventure pack.
  ONE GAME .... only the figures that came out in that game, sorted
                like ALL.
  FAVORITES and YOUR LISTS .... the ones you made on the phone, in the
                order you added the figures (only lists with figures in
                them).

NICKNAMES: press START on a figure and a keyboard comes up.
  D-pad ........ move around the keys
  A ............ type the key (DEL deletes, CAPS for capitals, DONE saves)
  B ............ delete a letter        X ...... space
  Y ............ capitals on / off      START .. save
  BACK ......... cancel
Up to 20 letters. The nickname shows under the figure's name, on the TV
and on the phone. Save it empty to take it away. Nicknames are kept in
The Static Rift\nicknames.ini; the figure's own file isn't changed.

Game progress is saved back into the figure file (a backup is kept in
The Static Rift\Backups).


7. THE PHONE REMOTE
------------------
Pick figures from your phone (or a tablet or a PC) while you play.
1. Your phone has to be on the same Wi-Fi as the Xbox.
2. Start a Skylanders game. About 10 seconds in, a pop-up says
   "Phone remote: open http://192.168.1.23" (your Xbox's address).
   The address also shows under THE STATIC RIFT at the top of the menu.
3. Type that address into your phone's browser (Safari, Chrome...).
   Tip: "Add to Home Screen" makes it open like an app next time.

On the page:
  ON THE RIFT ...... what's on the portal. The X takes one off; "Clear
                     all" (tap it twice) empties the portal.
  Search ........... type part of a name (or of a nickname).
  All / My Picks /
  the games ........ the same lists as the menu on the TV.
  Tap a figure ..... Put on the Rift, Swap in or Take off, and:
                     - its nickname: tap "+ Add a nickname" under its
                       name (or the nickname, to change or remove it).
                       It shows on each card between the name and the
                       series / game, and on the TV.
                     - Favorite: the star. Favorites get their own tab
                       (and a star on their card).
                     - Lists: put it in your own lists, or make a new
                       one with it in it.
  + New list ....... (at the end of the tabs) make a list of your own:
                     a roster, a speedrun, anything. Each list gets its
                     own tab, with Rename and Delete at the top.
  Quick tap ........ (the lightning button, next to Clear all) for
                     speedruns: one tap on a figure swaps it in at
                     once, no details screen. Hold a figure (or
                     right-click on a PC) to see its details. Your
                     phone remembers it.
  The dot at the top: green = connected, yellow = reconnecting (a
                     second or two), red = not connected.

- It only works while a Skylanders game is running (it starts with the
  game and stops when you quit).
- It stays on your home network: nothing goes on the internet, there's
  nothing to install and nothing to pay for.
- The game doesn't pause for the phone, and the LB+RB menu on the TV keeps
  working too. Whatever you do on either one shows on both, straight away.
- Favorites and your lists show in the TV menu too (R3), and nicknames
  given on the TV show on the phone. They're kept in
  The Static Rift\lists.ini and nicknames.ini (updates never touch
  them).
- The page keeps one live connection and mends it by itself: after a
  Wi-Fi hiccup, or coming back from the lock screen, it catches up on
  its own. It's made to work in any phone browser (Safari, Chrome,
  Firefox, Samsung Internet...).
- The phone gets small copies of the card art from The Static Rift\Phone
  (both zips have them). A figure picture you added yourself still shows,
  it just loads slower; tools/mkphone.py (in the source) makes small
  copies of new pictures.


8. MY PICKS (YOUR ROSTERS)
--------------------------
Your rosters live in The Static Rift\picks.ini. Open it in Notepad.
One section (roster) per game, names separated by commas:

  [Giants]
  Tech = Legendary Bouncer, Drobot (series 2)

- My Picks shows the roster of the game you're playing first, then the
  earlier games' rosters. In Imaginators: Imaginators, SuperChargers,
  Trap Team, Swap Force, Giants, then Spyro's Adventure. In Spyro's
  Adventure: only that roster. The heading says whose roster you're in.
- Each roster is sorted like ALL.
- A SuperCharger you pick brings its vehicle.
- After the rosters: every creation crystal, trap, vehicle, magic item and
  adventure pack the game can use.
- Put a game in front to pick that game's release:
      Trap Team Eon's Elite Chop Chop
- Put a series after to pick that series:  Drobot (series 2)
- Small spelling mistakes are OK.


9. SETTINGS
-----------
Edit The Static Rift\staticrift.ini in Notepad. Changes apply the next time
you start a Skylanders game.

  PauseGame = 0 ............ keep the game running behind the menu
  FullScreenMenu = 0 ....... use the plainer pop-up menu instead
  SortByType = 0 ........... list figures folder by folder
  NewestOnly = 1 ........... ALL shows only each Skylander's newest release
  OnlyCompatible = 0 ....... show figures from later games too
  Modifier = LB+RB ......... the buttons that open the menu
  SwapGapMs = 150 .......... Swap in's pause between the old figure
                             coming off and the new one going on, in
                             milliseconds (0 = as fast as the game
                             takes it; raise it if a game ever hangs
                             right after a swap)
  [Remote] Enabled = 0 ..... turn the phone remote off
  [Remote] Port = 80 ....... its port (if 80 is taken it uses 8080, and
                             the pop-up shows the address with :8080)


10. YOUR OWN FIGURES
--------------------
Put any 1 KB figure dump (.dump or .bin) anywhere inside
The Static Rift\Figures and it shows up in the menu.
File names must be 42 characters or shorter (Xbox limit).


11. IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
---------------------------
- The phone can't open the page:
    Wait for the "Phone remote" pop-up first (about 10 seconds into the
    game). Type the address exactly, with http:// in front. The phone has
    to be on your home Wi-Fi (not mobile data, not a guest network). Some
    routers stop devices from talking to each other ("AP isolation" or
    "client isolation" in the router's settings): turn that off. Still
    nothing? Send staticrift.log (the lines starting "Phone remote:").
- The phone page says "Not connected":
    The game has to be running (the remote stops at the dashboard) and
    the phone has to be on the same Wi-Fi. It reconnects by itself once
    it can reach the Xbox; reloading the page works too.
- No "The Static Rift is open" message:
    Peer Pressure: check KaosByte.xex and the six .ini files are in
      Hdd1\PeerPressure\SideLoading.
    Dashlaunch: check the launch.ini line (right file, right path, "Hdd:",
      a space around =, a free plugin number) and that you restarted.
- "Portal Disconnected" (RGH/JTAG): another plugin may be hooking the game
    first. This version works around that by itself. If it still happens, or
    for anything else:
    Quit the game back to the dashboard (don't restart), then send
    Hdd1\The Static Rift\staticrift.log
    (after a crash or freeze, send staticrift-previous.log too).
    Say which download you used and which game you tested.
